name: Gravity
author: mahziyarng98
description: An orbital launcher that surfaces the apps you actually use, ranked by how often you open them

barWidget.description: An orbital launcher that surfaces the apps you actually use, ranked by how often you open them

schema.label: Pinned apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes that always hold a slot, in orbit order, e.g. "v2rayn, org.gnome.Nautilus". Run `hyprctl clients -j | grep class` to read a window's class.

schema.label: Ignored apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes that never earn a slot, however often they are launched.

schema.label: Apps in orbit
schema.description: How many icons sit on the ring. Six is the maximum the circle holds.

schema.label: Seconds per revolution
schema.description: How long the orbit takes to come back around. Rotation pauses whenever an icon is hovered or keyboard-selected.
